# opnsense_system_dns (Resource)

Manages OPNsense system DNS resolver settings through `os-api-extensions`. This is a singleton resource. `os-api-extensions` version 0.11 or newer must be installed first.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `servers` (List of String) Ordered IPv4/IPv6 DNS server addresses used by the OPNsense host resolver.

### Optional

- `allow_override` (Boolean) Allow dynamic interfaces to add DNS servers. Defaults to `false`.
- `use_local_service` (Boolean) Prepend localhost when a local DNS service is active. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier `system_dns`.
